name: mirage
text: Found the cause of the vanishing bets, from the report your phone saved to GitHub. At the start of every engine scan, about every 75 seconds, the list GitHub publishes holds only the Novig prices that scan has re-read so far. So it is nearly empty, and it refills over about 15 seconds. Your log shows it: 8 to 16 bets dropping to 0 right after each new list, about 20 times in 20 minutes. The odds were not stale. The rows are priced 1 to 3 minutes ago and the list just hid them. I fixed it so the list keeps rows the new scan hasn't re-read yet, with their own ages, as long as their Novig price is under 4 minutes old and their fair price isn't too old. I'm restarting the engine now so it runs the fix, which takes a few minutes, and releasing 1.0.77 (the phone isn't changed). There are no 'no one was selling' entries in your log yet, because it logs only when a bet is tried. Try a few bets and I'll read them.
